selectionFrames.label: Complete 2022 Kindle Storyteller Award shortlist
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all five shortlisted titles, with no provider-result filtering.

selectionFrames.label: Complete 2023 Kindle Storyteller Award shortlist
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all five shortlisted titles, with no provider-result filtering.

selectionFrames.label: Complete 2024 Kindle Storyteller Award shortlist
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all five shortlisted titles reported by the publishing trade press, with no provider-result filtering. Amazon's winner announcement independently confirms that the award covered KDP-published works.

selectionFrames.label: Complete 2025 Kindle Storyteller Award shortlist
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all five shortlisted titles, with no provider-result filtering.

selectionFrames.label: Complete 2025 Selfies Book Awards adult fiction shortlist
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all six adult fiction titles on the official 2025 Selfies shortlist, with no provider-result filtering.

selectionFrames.label: Complete 2024 Selfies Book Awards adult fiction shortlist
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all seven adult fiction titles on the official 2024 Selfies winners page, with no provider-result filtering. The page states that the category covers books self-published in the UK in 2023.

selectionFrames.label: Complete 2023 Selfies Book Awards adult fiction shortlist
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all eight adult fiction titles in the official 2023 Selfies shortlist release, with no provider-result filtering. The release states that the judges were selecting the best indie-published books of 2022.

selectionFrames.label: Complete 2025 Selfies Book Awards general non-fiction shortlist
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all six general non-fiction titles on the official 2025 Selfies shortlist, with no provider-result filtering. Treat the complete nonfiction shortlist as a standalone challenge frame, not as evidence that any selected work lacks a bibliographic relationship.

selectionFrames.label: Complete 2026 Selfies Book Awards fiction shortlist
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all six fiction titles on the official 2026 Selfies results page, with no provider-result filtering. The award FAQ limits the 2026 prize to English-language books self-published during 2025.

selectionFrames.label: Complete Penguin Random House stand-alone science fiction and fantasy list observed 2026-09-04
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all sixteen titles present on the publisher list at the observation date, with no provider-result filtering.

selectionFrames.label: Complete Hachette standalone books for romantasy fans list observed 2026-09-04
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all eight titles under the publisher's standalone heading at the observation date, including any label contradicted by stronger current relational evidence, with no provider-result filtering.

selectionFrames.label: Complete Hachette standalone SFF horror section observed 2026-09-06
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all nine titles under the publisher list's Horror heading at the observation date, including ambiguous labels and any label contradicted by stronger current relational evidence, with no provider-result filtering.

selectionFrames.label: Complete Fern Michaels 2024 matching-year release frame
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include every distinct title on the author's complete 2024 releases page whose matching entry in her complete bibliography records 2024, with no provider-result filtering. The intersection yields The Wild Side, Tiny Blessings, Proof, Santa's Secret, and Backwater Justice while excluding reissues whose bibliography year predates 2024.

selectionFrames.label: Complete Fern Michaels 2025 matching-year release frame
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include every distinct title on the author's complete 2025 releases page whose matching entry in her complete bibliography records 2025, with no provider-result filtering. The intersection yields Fight or Flight, Lilac Time, Smuggler's Cove, Santa's Holiday Spectacular, and Code Blue while excluding reissues whose bibliography year predates 2025.

selectionFrames.label: Complete current Kiersten Modglin standalone catalog frame
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all 47 distinct titles under Standalones and Standalones (continued) in the author's current complete book-list PDF, in listed publication order, with no provider-result filtering. Do not include the separately labelled Arrangement Novels or The Messes Series. The selection heading is a challenge label, not gold truth; every title remains unresolved until exact-work authority evidence confirms or contradicts it.

selectionFrames.label: Complete Penguin Random House 2026 fantasy and science fiction list observed 2026-09-06
selectionFrames.selectionRule: Include all 30 titles on the publisher's New Fantasy and Science Fiction To Read This Year page at the observation date, in displayed order, with no series or standalone-result filtering. The page's structured data supplies the title, contributor, ISBN, 2026 date, and exact product URL for every selected work; classification requires the separate exact product page.

strata.label: Reverie seeded series
strata.description: One difficult work from each distinct series represented in Reverie's seed.

strata.label: Recent independent or Kindle-first
strata.description: Works first published from 2021 onward through an independent or Kindle-first path.

strata.label: Recent traditionally published
strata.description: Works first published from 2021 onward through a traditional publisher.

strata.label: Multi-series or connected-universe
strata.description: Works likely to expose primary-series, secondary-series, or universe false positives.

strata.label: Publisher or author standalone challenges
strata.description: Works selected from affirmative standalone labels, including labels later disproved by stronger current relational evidence; the separate standalone hard gate counts only reviewed true negatives.
